competitors.title: Easy Opposite Words for Kids | Fast-Slow, Stop-Go, Yes-No (Adi Connection)
Opposite Words in English | Hot-Cold, Fast-Slow, Heavy-Light (Adi Connection)

angle: Learning goal: fast vs slow. Story: Tiko zooms by (fast!), a friendly snail inches along (slow...). Pip asks 'Who is fast? Who is slow?' (pause-and-guess, Pip glows on the answer). Twist: Tiko slows down to walk WITH the snail and they finish together; everyone cheers. Repeat both words at matching speeds.
hook: ZOOM! Tiko runs by so fast!
strengths: Motion is the lesson (perfect for animation); kindness payoff avoids the 'same outcome' template risk; extends the opposites playlist
weaknesses: Same concept family as 'Which One Is BIG?' - space them out and vary the story; needs one new snail character
